superstore.label: Superstore Sales
superstore.description: Retail orders from a US superstore with sales, profit, discount and customer details.

column_notes.Sales: Revenue of the order line in USD
column_notes.Profit: Profit of the order line in USD (can be negative)
column_notes.Order Date: Date the order was placed; use for trends over time

students.label: Students Performance
students.description: Exam scores of 1000 students with demographic and background information.

hr_attrition.label: IBM HR Attrition
hr_attrition.description: Fictional IBM employee data used to study attrition.

column_notes.MonthlyIncome: Monthly salary in USD (this is the 'salary' column)
column_notes.Department: Sales, Research & Development or Human Resources

netflix.label: Netflix Titles
netflix.description: Movies and TV shows available on Netflix with cast, country, rating and release info.

column_notes.duration: Text such as '90 min' (movies) or '2 Seasons' (TV shows)
column_notes.date_added: Date the title was added to Netflix
